spans.s:
तोमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
 1. An iron club or crow.
 2. A lance.
 E. तु Sautra
root, to hurt, affix विच्, तु that which injures, मृ to die, affix
करणे अच्, and the vowel of तु changed.

तोमरग्रह m. (-हः) A warrior armed with a club.
 E. तोमर, and ग्रह who takes.

. A warrior armed with a club.
E. तोमर an iron club, and धर having.
तोमरिका f. (-का) A fragrant earth: see तुवरिका ।
